facts.fact: The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications' National Data Governance Policy carries a cover reading draft, a Document Control version of Final dated March 2026, and a closing line that it will be published upon approval; the text records no approval or launch by the government.

note: No fact on use: the Inter-Ministerial Committee (MoPT, Ministry of Justice, FIA) is described as leading development of the policy, which answers the draft question, and the Independent Information Commission's extended mandate is only proposed.
